eventDetail.eventTitle: 2027 Asia Conference on Advances in Artificial Intelligence and Education (AAIE)
eventDetail.keywords: Artificial Intelligence,Educational Technology,AI Agents and Copilots in Education,Adaptive and Personalized Learning Systems,AI in Education,
eventDetail.scope: The 2027 Asia Artificial Intelligence and Education Conference (AAIE 2027) is a multidisciplinary academic event that bridges the cutting edge of artificial intelligence with the evolving landscape of educational technology. Its scope encompasses three broad, interconnected pillars: core Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies, such as Foundation Models, Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and Autonomous Systems; Educational Technology (EdTech) applications, including Learning Analytics, Adaptive Learning, and Intelligent Tutoring Systems; and the critical intersection of AI in Education (AI + EdTech Integration), which explores areas like AI-driven personalized learning, human-AI collaboration in the classroom, and the ethical and inclusive deployment of AI for global education.
